agent-execution.definition: Agent Runtime + Capability Worker (Rust); one version unit, two isolated processes.

gateway-control.definition: Public API, auth, tenant, model routing, quota, billing, admin plane (Python).

infrastructure.decision: Shared physical infrastructure with logical namespaces, not ownerless buckets (PRD §5).
infrastructure.definition: PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, object storage, observability stores.

knowledge.decision: successor ADR-008; knowledge schema + Qdrant dataset collection contract
knowledge.definition: Knowledge API + Knowledge Worker (Python); one code unit, two runtime roles.

product-surface.definition: Frontend console; no persistent data of its own.

docker-compose.build.yml.role: override/build overlay — not an additional service set

docker-compose.capability.yml.role: explicitly empty local-live capability override (opt-in Docker socket trust)

docker-compose.dev.yml.role: override/build overlay — not an additional service set

docker-compose.kbms.yml.role: override/build overlay — not an additional service set

knowledge_routes.note: Decorators counted before prefix assembly; knowledge-service mounts its routers under /api/v1 (see apps/knowledge-service/src/knowledge_service/main.py).

methodology: Compose services parsed structurally from docker-compose*.yml by scripts/inventory/service_topology.py.
Gateway route surface taken from the published snapshot sdk/openapi.json; it is the contract authority frozen in contract-freeze.json.
Knowledge route surface is a static AST decorator scan; it excludes mounted prefixes but is stable for drift comparison.
scale_support values are current facts per PRD §5.1, not promises.

services.health_contract: readiness checks execution store; per-capability downstream health (ARC-05 target)
services.notes: Fixed container_name blocks multi-replica compose scaling until removed (ARC-06).
services.process_role: Rust capability executor (tool workspaces, provider-free execution)
services.scale_support: conditional: durable claim/recovery/cancel/side-effect-unknown proof required first (PRD §5.1)

services.health_contract: Runtime readiness reports kernel+store; optional capability loss must not unready it (ARC-05 target)
services.notes: Fixed container_name blocks multi-replica compose scaling until removed (ARC-06).
services.process_role: Rust Agent Runtime kernel (Thread/Turn/Item, leases, snapshots)
services.scale_support: currently-no: thread affinity and cross-instance event notification unsolved (PRD §5.1)

services.health_contract: static asset delivery; no readiness probe of its own

services.notes: Fixed container_name blocks multi-replica compose scaling until removed (ARC-06).
services.scale_support: currently-no: background scheduler has no leader lease; in-process SSE/thread ownership (PRD §5.1)
services.state_owner: gateway schema objects, sessions, quota/billing, assistant facades

services.process_role: one-shot init job (not a long-running service)

services.notes: Fixed container_name blocks multi-replica compose scaling until removed (ARC-06).
services.process_role: Knowledge API role of knowledge_service (KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_ROLE selects api/worker/all)
services.scale_support: yes for API role (stateless request handling)
services.state_owner: knowledge schema objects; Qdrant dataset collection contract

services.health_contract: worker loop liveness; job claim/recovery semantics are ARC-05 targets
services.notes: Fixed container_name blocks multi-replica compose scaling until removed (ARC-06).
services.process_role: Knowledge Worker role of the same knowledge_service code unit (no separate schema)
services.scale_support: conditional: durable claim/generation recovery must be proven (PRD §5.1)
services.state_owner: same knowledge domain as knowledge-service; no separate schema

services.notes: Not a Compose service: runs on the user's machine; compose files define no local-node entry.
services.process_role: host-side daemon (apps/local-node), started by the end user, not by Compose

services.health_contract: runs to completion; failure blocks dependent services
services.process_role: one-shot migration job (not a long-running service)
services.scale_support: no (single migrator authority is an ARC-03 target)

services.process_role: PostgreSQL 16 (single cluster; per-service schema/role split is ARC-03)
services.scale_support: vertical only in this program (no physical split planned)
services.state_owner: all relational state; schema.sql + migrations are the DDL authority

services.process_role: Qdrant vector store shared by knowledge dataset collections and agent memory vectors
services.scale_support: single instance; collection namespaces owned per data-access-inventory.json
services.state_owner: dataset vectors (knowledge), agent memory vectors (gateway data governance)

services.scale_support: single instance; keyspace namespaced per owner (see data-access-inventory.json)
services.state_owner: cache only: sessions, service/task caches, rate limits; no durable system of record
